verdict.rationale: Kit says it offers "apps that connect your creator tools directly to Kit" and a Kit App Store. Its API overview mentions importing purchase data from e-commerce platforms, so some integration path exists, but the evidence points to an app ecosystem and a DIY API/webhooks route rather than named, maintained first-party connectors. Missing for 10: named first-party Stripe and Shopify integrations, any CDP/Segment integration, a product-database sync or connector, evidence that integrations are first-party maintained rather than built by third-party app developers, and independent corroboration.
